FAQ

Your agency questions, answered

Have a workflow in mind? Tell us how your agency manages client work and where you need more clarity.

Contact us

Who is Worklume designed for?

Worklume is designed for digital, creative, and marketing agencies managing several clients at once. It brings account managers, creatives, and delivery teams around the same project plan.

Will Worklume fit our existing workflow?

The product is being shaped around the tools agencies already use. Start with one client workflow, and discuss the file storage, communication, and review connections your team needs during a walkthrough.

How would we get started?

Start with one client, one project, and your usual review stages. Map the brief, deliverables, owners, and approval dates first, then use that structure as the starting point for future work.

Can each client have a different process?

That is the goal. A brand project, monthly content retainer, and website launch need different stages. Worklume is designed around client workspaces that reflect those differences.

Is Worklume available to use today?

This website presents the Worklume product concept. Account access, client workspaces, integrations, and live submissions are not enabled yet. Availability and security details will be confirmed before launch.
